tooltip.wokandbowl.wok_steamer.not_heate: No heat source below the wok
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.title: Wok & Bowl
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokTos: Seconds between toss prompts while cooking.
Seconds a player has to toss the wok after a prompt.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokSer: Seconds around the cooking time in which serving counts as perfect.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokBur: Seconds after the cooking time until the dish burns.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokThr: Food bonus in percent for three flame dishes.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokTwo: Food bonus in percent for two flame dishes.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.riceGr: Growth speed of rice and sticky rice. Higher is faster, wheat is about 1.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.sticky: Sticky rice pauses at every second growth stage until it is fertilized.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.tatami: Seconds of the Rested effect when eating Wok & Bowl food on tatami. 0 disables it.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.blockI: Shows what is inside a block and what can be done next when you look at it.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokOwn: Only the player who started a dish can add ingredients, toss and serve it.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokQua: Enables tossing, timing and flame ratings. When disabled, dishes never burn and always get three flames.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.rattan: How many blocks around the rattan basket it collects from.
How fast harvested rattan branches grow back. Higher is faster.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.ingred: How many items fit into each slot of the ingredient cubby.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.rattan: Chance per free jungle log side to grow a rattan branch during world generation.
Shows falling leaves when harvesting or breaking rattan branches.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.cushio: Floor cushions bounce you up when you land on them.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.burntR: How long burnt rice burns as furnace fuel. 1600 equals charcoal, 0 disables it.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokRec: Shows which ingredients can start, continue and finish a dish when looking at the wok.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.cleave: Mobs and players killed with a cleaver always drop their head, if they have one.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.steami: How fast the bamboo steamer works. Higher is faster.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.ricePa: Rice paddies can only be made from Farm & Charm fertilized farmland. When disabled, regular farmland works too.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.paperL: How bright a lit paper lantern is. Changes need a restart.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokSte: Shows steam when pouring liquids into the wok and above finished dishes.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.basket: Shows items flying into the rattan basket when it collects them.
tooltip.wokandbowl.banner.thankyou_1: A reward for cooking all Dishes
tooltip.wokandbowl.banner.thankyou_3: Thank you for playing Wok & Bowl!
tooltip.wokandbowl.banner.thankyou_4: Grants Speed in a radius of 8 blocks
advancement.wokandbowl.root.desc: Find wild rice in swamps or, rarely, along rivers
advancement.wokandbowl.cook_everything.d: Cook every dish of Wok & Bowl
advancement.wokandbowl.plant_rice.desc: Dig fertilized farmland into a rice paddy with a shovel, flood it and plant rice
advancement.wokandbowl.sticky_rice.desc: Harvest sticky rice – fertilize it whenever it stops growing
advancement.wokandbowl.get_cleaver.desc: Craft a cleaver and place it on a cutting board
advancement.wokandbowl.cut_salmon.desc: Hold right-click with a salmon on a cutting board with a cleaver
advancement.wokandbowl.seaweed_salmon_ro: Stack ingredients on a cutting board and assemble seaweed salmon rolls
advancement.wokandbowl.cleaver_kill.desc: Defeat a mob with a cleaver
advancement.wokandbowl.place_wok.desc: Place a wok on a campfire or stove
advancement.wokandbowl.fermented_sauce.d: Brew fermented sauce in a Farm & Charm cooking pot
advancement.wokandbowl.first_wok_dish.de: Add ingredients, toss when the wok calls and finish with fermented sauce
advancement.wokandbowl.burnt_rice.desc: Let a dish burn in the wok
advancement.wokandbowl.steamed_to_perfec: Put a bamboo steamer on a heated wok and steam dumplings or buns
advancement.wokandbowl.rattan_cane.desc: Harvest rattan canes from a jungle tree
advancement.wokandbowl.well_rested.desc: Enjoy a Wok & Bowl meal on tatami
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.firefl: Shows fireflies above wild rice and around lit paper lanterns outdoors at night.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.cushio: Feathers fly up when you land on a floor cushion.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.itemTo: Shows extra tooltips on Wok & Bowl items.
tooltip.wokandbowl.placed_on_wok: Can be placed on a Wok
tooltip.wokandbowl.cutting_board.info_0: Place a Knife or Cleaver on it, then hold Right-Click with an Ingredient to chop it.
tooltip.wokandbowl.cutting_board.info_1: Place an Axe on it to strip Logs.
tooltip.wokandbowl.cutting_board.info_2: Without a Tool, stack Ingredients and Right-Click with an empty Hand to assemble a Dish.
tooltip.wokandbowl.cutting_board.info_3: Results go into a nearby open Ingredient Cubby or Rattan Basket.
tooltip.wokandbowl.ingredient_cubby.info: Holds four Ingredients. Click the Top to fill or take from a Compartment.
Click a Side to open or close it.
When open, catches what you chop on a nearby Cutting Board.
tooltip.wokandbowl.rattan_basket.info_1: Also catches Items dropped on top of it.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.ironCl: How often an ingredient has to be chopped with an iron cleaver.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.diamon: How often an ingredient has to be chopped with a diamond cleaver.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.nether: How often an ingredient has to be chopped with a netherite cleaver.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokTos: Tossing right when the wok calls for it keeps the dish perfect. Tossing late costs half a flame and makes it smoke.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokPer: How many ticks after the toss call still count as a perfect toss. 20 ticks are one second.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokCam: How fast the wok and steamer work on a campfire. Higher heat also shortens the toss and serve windows.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokSto: How fast the wok and steamer work on a stove or any other heat source.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokSou: How fast the wok and steamer work on a soul campfire.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.tatami: Extra Rested duration in percent for every flame above the first.
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokSou: Food bonus in percent for perfect dishes cooked on soul fire, which earn soul flames.
advancement.wokandbowl.soul_flames.desc: Serve a perfect dish cooked over soul fire
advancement.wokandbowl.mixed_stir_fry.de: Throw whatever you have into the wok
text.autoconfig.wokandbowl.option.wokDis: How many dishes one finished wok serving gives.
